insight: Melee heroes have built-in damage block on basic attacks, making them significantly more durable than ranged heroes. Ranged heroes take substantially more damage from creeps and enemy heroes.

Primary attribute grants +1 attack damage per point. Strength heroes gain health/regen, agility heroes gain attack speed/armor, intelligence heroes gain mana/mana regen/magic resistance. Universal heroes gain +0.5 attack damage per point in any attribute.
Most heroes have 1.7 base attack time. Lower values indicate fast attackers, higher values indicate slow attackers. Base attack time combined with attack speed stat determines damage output.
Passive skills work automatically without button presses. Aura-type passives work in a radius around the hero. Monitor buff/debuff indicators above your bottom panel to track passive effects.

Active skills come in multiple types: point target (click ground), unit target (click unit), vector target (point then direction), and no target (instant effect). Check ability descriptions to understand targeting requirements.
Choose talent trees at levels 10, 15, 20, and 25. Talents either enhance specific skills or provide stat bonuses. You can select unchosen talents at levels 27-30 to customize your late-game scaling.
Select your facet at game start. Facets can range from minor situational benefits to completely changing hero playstyle. Consult guides or experienced players to avoid disadvantageous facet choices.
Each hero has a unique innate ability that ranges from minor buffs to defining mechanics. Prioritize learning the innate of heroes you main.
